name: @gewislab/sciforge-oss
description: Skill-driven universal AI Scientist framework v1.8.0 — Markdown skills (domain-agnostic method) + runtime kernel (code-enforced 26-node control loop, event-sourced resume, mechanical gates, HITL approvals, RSI skill-library evolution) + ScientistTwo parity layer (subset→full-set ladder gate, ablation ledger, score<8 rebuttal + meta-review, anchor calibration, completeness audit, CPU bench/s2demo) + v1.7.3 evidence cross-validation (fairness/smoke gates reconcile against raw artifacts, DOI resolved online), factory daemon (persistent queue, multi-worker, token-authenticated control plane), and a no-LLM mock-host end-to-end harness over the full DAG. v1.7.4 adds a hash-chained event log with immutable run flags (human checkpoints can no longer be self-approved by editing RUNSTATE or appending events), a real LLM mutator behind the RSI search, mechanical review-panel independence disclosure, and disclosed 2-layer citation verification when Semantic Scholar is unreachable. v1.8.0 hardens the runtime against defects a real ARC-Bench run exposed (citation-relevance gate, cross-axis figure-tick collisions, macOS sandbox venv/sysctl, a battery-wide audit-has-no-side-effects invariant, cross-process event-log locking), wires a genuinely heterogeneous review panel (opt-in via SCIFORGE_PROVIDERS), and adds a disk-derived PRODUCTION_LEDGER so steady output is verifiable. Hosts: Claude Code / Codex / manual CLI. Headless on Linux/macOS/Windows.
